title: Between vulnerability and resilience: A network analysis of fluctuations in cognitive risk and protective factors following remission from depression
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - ESM procedure limited in variables that can be repeatedly assessed; - Subjective resilience ratings may overlap with other constructs; - Data limited in time and do not provide diagnostic information for recurrence; - Sample limited to remitted depressed patients, not generalizable to other disorders.
notes: The paper mentions the study was pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/g2k4w), but does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The OSF page for the registration is accessible but does not provide details on data or code availability. The authors may have declared availability in supplementary materials or on the OSF page, but this is not explicitly stated in the paper.
